## Finite and infinite sequences {#ss1-finite-infinite}

::: {.split}
::: {.column-block}
<h3>Finite</h3>

$$2,4,6,\ldots,20$$

Stops at a final term.

Here $a_{10}=20$, with $1\le n\le10$.

:::
::: {.column-block}
<h3>Infinite</h3>

$$2,4,6,8,\ldots$$

Continues indefinitely.

There is no final index.

:::
:::

::: {.takeaway}
An ellipsis can appear inside a finite sequence. Check whether a final term is specified.
:::

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 1 · Section 1.1</p>

::: notes
Use the intended even-number rule in both examples. A screen showing only a few terms of an OEIS entry does not establish that the sequence is finite. Distinguish the definition's domain from how much of a list is displayed.
:::
